description: This file declares the interfaces for the Slap Sco Collection Object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It defines function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, initializing, and resetting SLAP Sco Collection objects, serving as an exported API for these operations. It includes licensing, copyright, and descriptive comments but contains no actual implementation or class definitions.

methods.name: SlapCreateScoCollection
methods.description: Creates a new SLAP Sco Collection object with provided context handles.

methods.name: SlapScoColCreate
methods.description: Creates a SLAP Sco Collection instance with specified context.

methods.name: SlapScoColRemove
methods.description: Removes a SLAP Sco Collection object.

methods.name: SlapScoColEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrols necessary objects into the SLAP Sco Collection.

methods.name: SlapScoColInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the SLAP Sco Collection object.

methods.name: SlapScoColReset
methods.description: Resets the SLAP Sco Collection object to its default state.
